credits.title: Fresh Meat
credits.overview: In the back of a butcher shop, a little girl watches terrifying tales on a screen that must be fed. As its appetite grows, her father must find increasingly gruesome ways to keep the show going.

credits.title: Dagnabbit!
credits.overview: A homeowner. A crawlspace. An unwanted guest.

credits.title: Checkpoint
credits.overview: After mysteriously awakening in a barren alien landscape, a self-serving prisoner must conquer a series of grueling trials in order to reunite with his lost love.

credits.title: Disembodies
credits.overview: A lovelorn underdog buys a novelty meteorite as part of a romantic gesture to win his ex back, but when the gift proves to have a mind of its own, he must purge himself of the parasitic entity before it consumes him.

credits.title: The Sacred Disease
credits.overview: A bereaved epileptic ditches her pills and follows a mysterious woman to the outskirts of her town, where she slips back into the fearsome yet ecstatic throes of the seizure.

credits.title: The Pocketwatch
credits.overview: Mark is alone and afraid. After thousands disappeared and the world descended into chaos, he left to find a new life. But without food and fresh water, how long can he survive? Lucas and his trusted friends are holding up in an abandoned college, but finding new food is dangerous and risky. How long will they hold out?
